evals.prompt: What can Robot Framework Hub do from this suite repo, and which MCP tools should I use?
evals.expected_output: Routes to the map: prefer MCP over UI scrape; names connect/queue/investigate/write-* sub-skills.

evals.prompt: We're using rfhub — should I queue this suite or look at yesterday's failures first?
evals.expected_output: Picks rfhub-queue vs rfhub-investigate from intent; does not start editing .robot files.

evals.prompt: Run acceptance for this commit in accpt, then tell me the report verdict for the release notes.
evals.expected_output: Routes run-acceptance to rfhub-queue (rfhub_acceptance_run, poll groupId) and the verdict read to rfhub-investigate (report first); does not route to rfhub-write-acceptance or start editing .robot files.
